document.title: Musharraf [EXCISED] (Islamabad 05087)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), "No-Go" Tribal Areas Became Basis for Afghan Insurgency Documents Show
document.note: [Secret - Noforn] Two days after 9/11, Ambassador Wendy Chamberlin bluntly tells Musharraf that the attacks changed the fundamentals of the debate. There was absolutely no inclination in Washington to enter into a dialogue with the Taliban, and the time for dialogue ended September 11. She says the Taliban are harboring the terrorists responsible for the attacks.

mentions.quote: PRESIDENT MUSHARRAF INVITED HER INTO A PRIVATE MEETING FOLLOWING THE FIVE-AMBASSADOR CEREMONY.

persons.name: Wendy Chamberlin
persons.role: U.S. Ambassador to Pakistan, presenting credentials

mentions.quote: AMBASSADOR PRESENTED HER CREDENTIALS JUST BEFORE NOON ON THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 13.
FOREIGN SECRETARY INAM UL HAQUE, MILITARY SECRETARY TO THE PRESIDENT BRIG. NADEEM TAJ
MILITARY SECRETARY TO THE PRESIDENT BRIG. NADEEM TAJ, AND DCM (NOTETAKER) ALSO ATTENDED.
PRESIDENT BUSH WAS, IN FACT, REFERRING TO THE TALIBAN IN HIS SPEECH PROMISING TO GO AFTER THOSE WHO HARBORED TERRORISTS.

persons.role: Al-Qa'ida leader, suspected of the September 11 attacks

events.description: Forty-minute private meeting between Musharraf and Amb. Chamberlin after the credentials ceremony; the US said there was no inclination to dialogue with the Taliban.
Ambassador presented her credentials in a five-ambassador ceremony.
September 11 attacks, which the US blamed on UBL and al-Qa'ida.
September 11 attacks, attributed by the U.S. to UBL and al-Qaida.
Ambassador Chamberlin presented credentials just before noon in a five-ambassador ceremony.

Forty-minute private meeting between Musharraf and Ambassador Chamberlin, attended by Inam ul Haque, Nadeem Taj and the DCM; Ambassador said time for dialogue with the Taliban was over and the U.S. believed UBL/al-Qaida guilty.
Ambassador told Musharraf that Washington was putting the building blocks of the action plan in place.

key_claims: The US Ambassador told Musharraf the 9/11 attacks changed the fundamentals of debate.
The US had no inclination to engage in dialogue with the Taliban after 9/11.
The US believed the Taliban were harboring those responsible for 9/11.
The US considered UBL and al-Qa'ida the likely culprits.
The US stated that NATO, UN and Congress had pledged support, including logistical, for action.
